{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793062375610,"sessionID":"ses_e8528d45bffewfJv7zOlzY9fWp","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"edit","callID":"toolu_01V2djPkr8Wxx7yueeaFkBPq","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/nbody.cpp","oldString":"void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n        \n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            \n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        \n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}","newString":"// One thread per body. Source positions are staged through shared memory in\n// tiles of BLOCK_SIZE bodies. Each thread still accumulates its force over\n// j = 0..n-1 in increasing order, so the summation order matches the serial\n// algorithm. Only the velocity of body i is written, and positions are only\n// read, so there are no data races.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(Body* bodies, int n) {\n    __shared__ double sx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double sy[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double sz[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = i < n;\n\n    double xi = 0.0, yi = 0.0, zi = 0.0;\n    if (active) {\n        xi = bodies[i].pos.x;\n        yi = bodies[i].pos.y;\n        zi = bodies[i].pos.z;\n    }\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int base = 0; base < n; base += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = base + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            sx[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.x;\n            sy[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.y;\n            sz[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.z;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int count = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - base);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            const double dx = sx[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = sy[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = sz[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void integrateKernel(Body* bodies, int n) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < n) {\n        bodies[i].pos.x += bodies[i].vel.x * DT;\n        bodies[i].pos.y += bodies[i].vel.y * DT;\n        bodies[i].pos.z += bodies[i].vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Runs all simulation steps on the GPU. Bodies are uploaded once, kept on the\n// device for every step, and copied back once at the end.\nvoid runSimulation(std::vector<Body>& bodies, int numSteps) {\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(bodies.size());\n    if (n == 0 || numSteps <= 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    Body* d_bodies = nullptr;\n    const size_t bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(Body);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_bodies, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_bodies, bodies.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int numBlocks = (n + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForcesKernel<<<numBlocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        integrateKernel<<<numBlocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bodies.data(), d_bodies, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_bodies));\n}"},"output":"Edit applied successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"diff":"Index: /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/nbody.cpp\n===================================================================\n--- /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/nbody.cpp\n+++ /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/nbody.cpp\n@@ -43,41 +43,96 @@\n         body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n     }\n }\n \n-void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n-    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n-    \n-    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n-        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n-        \n-        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n-            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n-            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n-            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n+// One thread per body. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793062384094,"sessionID":"ses_e8528d45bffewfJv7zOlzY9fWp","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01Jj9i8f5WFAtBpjcSUoFSXq","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)\nproject(nbody_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Build for the GPUs present on this machine (override with -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=...)\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\nendif()\n\n# nbody.cpp contains CUDA kernels, so it is compiled by nvcc\nset_source_files_properties(nbody.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(nbody nbody.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations. Host-side flags are forwarded to the host compiler via -Xcompiler.\ntarget_compile_options(nbody PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native -Xcompiler=-Wall -Xcompiler=-Wextra>\n)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(nbody m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/nbody/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1793062384053,"end":1793062384062}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17ad8ab140018tRw1D162DnPKx","sessionID":"ses_e8528d45bffewfJv7zOlzY9fWp","messageID":"msg_17ad8a4610011snY4DjvxvBLSY"}}
